name: Comture Corporation
summary: Comture Corporation provides cloud, digital, business, platform and operation, and digital learning solutions in Japan. It offers cloud services, such as collaboration and CRM; and consulting, and integration services. The company also provides analysis solutions using big data and AI tools, as well as support services for the automation of business processes. In addition, it engages in the construction, operation, modernization and consulting of accounting, human resources, fintech, and other core systems.
